title: fix: make Polli CLI first run work
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Puts login and a low-cost text result at the top of the CLI README.
- Offers device login when an interactive generation command has no key, then resumes that command.
- Gives 402 responses direct balance, Quest, and top-up actions; key-budget errors still point to key settings.

Tests: CLI build and focused error tests (4 passed).

gist.headline: Polli finds the front door
gist.blurb: Polli CLI’s first run gets a gentler path: sign in when prompted, finish the command you started, and find a small text example right at the top of the README.
gist.summary: Polli CLI offers device login when an interactive generation command has no key and resumes that command afterward; its README leads with login and a low-cost text result, while 402 errors point to balance, Quests, and top-ups.
gist.impact: A first-time CLI user can authenticate without restarting their generation command, and a 402 response gives them direct next steps; key-budget errors still point to key settings.
gist.visual_concept: Polli CLI is a terminal tool, so depict a welcoming retro terminal beside a garden path: Polli opens a little login gate, with a short text result waiting beyond it. Small signposts for balance, Quests, and top-ups represent the 402 guidance; a separate key-settings sign keeps budget errors distinct.
